crumbs.apps: First crumb: the Apps page (small web apps socios build).
crumbs.open: Second crumb: the page that signs the person in to an app and opens it.
failed: Error when the app could not open, without a reason from the server.
error-title: Title when the app could not open.
error-detail: Text after the server's error (in English). <apps> wraps the link to the Apps page; keep the tag around it.
